args.summary: Two charges of 2,500,000 NGN for customer cust_01 on separate orders (ord_0001 and ord_0002) created 40 seconds apart. Both succeeded at provider. Requires verification of whether both orders are legitimate or if one charge should be refunded.

proposal.rationale: Two charges exist on different orders for same customer and amount; human review needed to determine if both are legitimate or if one should be refunded.
